algorithm: LightGBM over RGB spatial, HSV histogram and texture features
source_preprocessing: EXIF orientation, at most 1024 pixels per side, lossless PNG staging; public uploads retain the 5 MiB / 16 million pixel limit
license: Dataset declared CC BY 4.0; preserve third-party provenance caveats
dataset_attribution: Md Shajedur Rahman, Corn Leaf Disease Classification Dataset (2026), DOI 10.17632/hmkd6nbngr.1
split: Deterministic 70/15/15 by unions of original filename and perceptual image hash; augmentation suffixes stripped before splitting
validation_limits: No verified physical leaf IDs or acquisition-session metadata; near-duplicates may remain.
Same-dataset held-out evaluation, not external field validation or diagnostic probability calibration.
limits: Candidate image classification, not a confirmed diagnosis or a measure of crop growth.
Only the five listed classes are supported; other plants and disorders may be misclassified.
A healthy label does not rule out disease or pests elsewhere on the plant or field.
Generic insect damage does not identify the insect species or prove fall armyworm.
No external field validation in Guatemala; background and lighting can affect the result.
Treatment choice requires local diagnosis, crop stage and a reviewed management guide.
generated_by: Training code assisted by OpenAI Codex (GPT-6); source images not AI-generated by this project
